meta.name: browser-cdp
meta.description: Use this skill when you need to control a Chrome browser via CDP (Chrome DevTools Protocol) to reuse existing login sessions. Covers: launching Chrome in debug mode, opening URLs, waiting for page load, evaluating JavaScript, taking snapshots, and extracting auth tokens. Trigger phrases: browser automation, CDP, agent-browser, 浏览器操作, 操作浏览器, Chrome CDP, 复用登录态, extract token from browser.

copy.tagline: 让脚本自动操作浏览器并复用现有登录状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你有一份已登录的浏览器会话,想通过脚本操作页面或取走登录凭证
copy.tagline_en: Control a browser with scripts and reuse an existing signed-in session
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a logged-in browser and want to script it or grab the auth token.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能通过 CDP 控制你电脑上的 Chrome，直接复用你已登录的网站会话（不用重新登录），帮你打开网页、读取页面文字、执行网页脚本、提取登录凭证，以及点击、输入等操作。
howto.when: 当你想让 Claude 操作 Chrome 浏览器、复用已登录的会话，或做浏览器自动化（打开网页、提取 token 等）时触发。例如说“浏览器操作”“复用登录态”“extract token from browser”等。

say.text: 用我已登录的浏览器打开公司内网页面，把页面文字发我。
say.note: Claude 会通过 CDP 打开该页面并读取文字给你。

say.text: 帮我从当前网页的 localStorage 提取 token。
say.note: Claude 会执行一条脚本读取 token 并告诉你。

say.text: 在网页上找到搜索框，输入“春节天气”并点击搜索。
say.note: Claude 会定位搜索框、输入文字并点击搜索。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can control Chrome via CDP, reusing your existing logged-in sessions (no re-login needed) to open pages, read page text, run scripts, extract auth tokens, and click/type.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask Claude to control Chrome, reuse a logged-in session, or automate a browser (open pages, extract tokens, etc.). Triggers: 'browser operation', 'reuse login state', 'extract token from browser'.

say_en.text: Open the intranet page in my logged-in Chrome and send me its text.
say_en.note: Claude opens the page via CDP and reads its text.

say_en.text: Extract the token from localStorage on the current page.
say_en.note: Claude runs a script to read the token.

say_en.text: Find the search box on the page, type 'spring weather', and click search.
say_en.note: Claude locates the box, types, and clicks.
